name: SGA Food for Fines
description: Furman Food for Fines is a collaborative initiative between SGA and FUPO designed to support local food security while providing students with an alternative way to resolve minor parking violations. Through this program, students can donate nonperishable food items in exchange for having an eligible parking citation waived. All collected items will be donated to Miracle Hill Food Warehouse in Greenville.

name: Senior Gift Donor Cord Pick-Up

name: Freshmen vs. Juniors Pickleball Tournament
description: This tournament will take place on Saturday, March 22nd, from 2:00 - 6:00 pm on the North Village courts. Grill food and snacks will be provided! Participants need to bring their own paddles and extra balls. Paddles will not be provided. Teams of two (both in the same grade) will compete in either a Beginner or Intermediate league for a prize! Message Grace Finkel (finkgr7@furman.edu) or Hannah McCoy (mccoha7@furman.edu) with any questions!

name: Burnout Music Festival
description: The first annual Burnout Music Festival is a glorious cumulation of three rock bands on campus. Complete with the Daily Havoc, the Balconies, the Lucky Sevens, and food trucks, how can you miss out?? ~~~ Lineup: The Lucky Sevens: 4:00-4:30pm The Balconies: 4:45-5:45pm The Daily Havoc: 6:00-7:00pm ~~~ This event, including the food, is open and free to the public. Join us and enjoy the some of the best rock music that Furman University has to offer!
